```typescript
function smoothPath(points: Point[], smoothingFactor = 0.3): string {
  if (points.length < 3) return pointsToPath(points);
  
  const smoothed: Point[] = [points[0]];
  
  for (let i = 1; i < points.length - 1; i++) {
    const prev = points[i - 1];
    const curr = points[i];
    const next = points[i + 1];
    
    smoothed.push({
      x: curr.x + (prev.x + next.x - 2 * curr.x) * smoothingFactor,
      y: curr.y + (prev.y + next.y - 2 * curr.y) * smoothingFactor
    });
  }
  
  smoothed.push(points[points.length - 1]);
  return catmullRomToPath(smoothed);
}
```
